entities.name: Kingdom of Dotawo
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: Dotawo was a Christian kingdom in Lower Nubia in the Middle Ages. It is attested in Old Nubian documents from the 12th to the 15th centuries. It is one of the last attested Christian states to survive in the region.
